articles.title: Tesla profits rose in the first quarter as Musk teases debut of new Roadster
articles.mainIdea: Tesla profits rose in the first quarter as Musk teases debut of new Roadster
articles.summary: Associated Press: Tesla profits rose in the first quarter as Musk teases debut of new Roadster. Tesla's profit rose in the first quarter as its car sales rebounded from a sharp slump in 2025. The electric vehicle maker run by billionaire Elon Musk said it earned $477 million in the quarter, up 17% from a year ago. Earnings per share totaled 13 cents. Related tickers mentioned: 002594.SZ, TSLA.
